scope: CRM, BMA-CRM and DA-CRM calendar trial replay and serial operating-characteristic simulation

sources.role: Design limits, cohort decisions, pending-data waits, Poisson arrivals, Weibull timing calibrated by window incidence and conditional late-event fraction, and operating-characteristic outputs.
CRM/BMA posterior inference and adaptive dose assignment across cohorts.
Data augmentation for delayed toxicity; separate from the simulation's true event-time distribution.

implementation_choices: Zero-based dose indices, fixed-dose staggered cohorts, and outcome-triggered reanalysis while enrollment is suspended.
The prospective patient is enrolled when a wait resolves; subsequent gaps run from actual enrollment and no queue accumulates.
Safety stopping is assessed at cohort boundaries; after maximum enrollment, final selection waits for complete ascertainment.
A safety stop remains a stop while enrolled patients finish follow-up; decision and final ascertainment times are reported separately.
Separate patient-generation and posterior-sampling random streams; retain compact summaries and release posterior draws.
Serial simulation and explicit likelihood-evaluation budgets; exhaustion raises rather than producing partial operating characteristics.
An explicit native_desktop profile starts at zero, retries waits at candidate arrivals, consumes the final patient gap, and separates the terminal assessment clock from actual ascertainment duration.
limitations: Native desktop scheduling and saved Suite study/report workflows now have bounded original-instruction and schema evidence (docs/crm-desktop.md). Native random sequences, adaptive-MCMC shortcuts/stopping, populated patient-file reopening and generated native reports remain unverified. Online application defaults are a separate contract.
